subject: Kickoff: cognate reflex prediction for low-resource lexicons
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the cognate reflexes project. Basis is our open-source SIGTYP 2022 shared-task work: two systems, a Cognate Neighbors model (the mockingbird-n1/n2 configurations) and a Cognate Inpainting model that treats reflex prediction like filling in missing cells of a cognate table.

Product framing: predicted reflexes let us bootstrap lexicons for low-resource languages where we have related-language data — the language portfolio's coverage OKR depends on exactly this kind of leverage. Milestones: reproduce shared-task numbers by end of April, pick a winning architecture by early June, hand a scored lexicon sample to the translation team by launch review in July.

Can you get me staffing plus a compute sketch by mid-April? Nothing exotic expected — these models are small.

Thanks,
Priya
